design_detail: Parliamentary reply on a domestic wealth tax
quote_original: Godongwana rejected the idea of imposing a direct tax on personal fortunes.
source_title: Godongwana says no to taxing the mega-rich
grading_note: The finance minister's reply to a parliamentary question rejects a domestic wealth tax. It does not mention the 2024 global levy, so it may not retract that; recorded as a retraction because the latest evidence decides who stays on the site. Replace this report with the reply itself when found.

quote_original: Créase un impuesto denominado impuesto al patrimonio.
quote_en: Create a tax called the wealth tax.
source_title: Ley 2277 de 2022 (reforma tributaria para la igualdad y la justicia social)
publisher: Secretaría del Senado de la República
grading_note: A law proposed by the Petro government (Hacienda under José Antonio Ocampo) and enacted by Congress; the government introduced the annual wealth tax in it.

quote_original: Petro subió el impuesto al patrimonio al 5%, el más alto del mundo, para recaudar, cubrir déficit fiscal y financiar gasto social nacional.
quote_en: Petro raised the wealth tax to 5%, the highest in the world, to raise revenue, cover the fiscal deficit and fund national social spending.
source_title: Colombia tendría la tasa a la riqueza más alta del mundo, luego de que Petro elevara impuesto al patrimonio al 5%
grading_note: A formal act of the government raising the rate of the wealth tax; reported by a newspaper.

design_detail: Aporte solidario y extraordinario, Ley 27.605: 2% to 3.5% on assets above 200 million pesos
quote_original: Créase, con carácter de emergencia y por única vez, un aporte extraordinario, obligatorio, que recaerá sobre las personas mencionadas en el artículo 2°
quote_en: An extraordinary, compulsory contribution is created, as an emergency measure and one time only, falling on the persons named in article 2
source_title: Ley 27605: Aporte solidario y extraordinario para ayudar a morigerar los efectos de la pandemia
grading_note: A law of Congress, driven by the governing coalition and promulgated and regulated by the government (Decreto 1024/2020, Decreto 42/2021): a formal act of the state. Levied on net wealth above 200 million pesos.
The executive promulgated the law by decree: the government's own act.

design_detail: Impuesto a las Grandes Fortunas (IGF), Ley 1357: net wealth above Bs 30 million
quote_original: Se crea en todo el territorio del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia, el Impuesto a las Grandes Fortunas - IGF, que se aplicará a la fortuna de las personas naturales.
quote_en: The Large Fortunes Tax (IGF) is created throughout the Plurinational State of Bolivia, to be applied to the fortune of natural persons.
source_title: Ley Nº 1357: Impuesto a las Grandes Fortunas - IGF
publisher: LexiVox (text of the law signed by President Arce)
grading_note: A law enacted and signed by President Arce's government creating an annual tax on the fortunes of natural persons. The Bs 30 million threshold is from secondary reports; check it against the Gaceta Oficial.

design_detail: Governing Labour Party campaigns to keep the wealth tax (September 2025 election)
quote_original: Labor wants to keep the wealth tax that has been a mainstay of Norwegian policy since 1892.
source_title: A longstanding tax on wealth is a central issue as prosperous Norway votes in a close election
grading_note: A party position, reported by AP, of the party that went on to form the government. Grade B: it keeps an existing tax; the government's budgets do the same (next row).

design_detail: Reform bill: wealth tax of up to 1.8% on fortunes above US$5 million
quote_original: se establece un impuesto a la riqueza de hasta el 1,8 por ciento para aquellos patrimonios que estén sobre los 5 millones de dólares.
quote_en: a wealth tax of up to 1.8 percent is established for fortunes above 5 million dollars.
source_title: En Chile presentan ambiciosa reforma tributaria
grading_note: The government's own tax reform proposal presented by Finance Minister Marcel. Another outlet (Bloomberg Línea) reported 1% above US$5 million and 2% above US$15 million; the schedule is to be checked against the bill itself.

quote_original: with a tax on billionaires, 2 billion people could be brought out of poverty
source_title: Cuba, 79th session General Debate: statement summary
grading_note: The UN's own summary of the foreign minister's speech to the General Assembly (also in the UN Meetings Coverage of 28 September 2024). Names a billionaire tax, no rate.

design_detail: A minimum global tax so that the super-rich pay more than workers
